hypothesis: TRAIN-induced pairwise conditional dependencies between an unknown causal law's truth-table entries improve forecast accuracy and total inference work on unfamiliar delayed-input entity relationships, relative to equally TRAIN-informed exact rule-prior Bayesian inference and fully trained independent-pattern controls.
mechanism: The model learns P(local-rule response bit j | already observed response bit k) for all 8 input patterns from public multientity intervention sequences. During test it maintains a persistent exact partial truth-table constraint memory, then updates probabilistic predictions for unobserved causal-input patterns using TRAIN-fitted conditional dependencies. Disable the weights and predictions revert to a TRAIN-fitted independent-pattern estimate. A distinct exact-certification channel emits a claim only when all hidden rule choices consistent with public data agree; never certifies a probable prediction.

R.temporal_delay: third input is node state two time steps ago

S.temporal_delay: second input is parent state one previous observation before latest

source.unknown_shared_rule: 3-input Boolean truth table with 8 bits, new per case; TRAIN polynomial algebraic normal form degree <=2, unseen DEV degree 3 (disjoint); no preloaded rule identity supplied
source.public_training_evidence: 3 reset-history intervention sequences with 2 selected next outputs each, including known 3-frame prior entity states, observed selected output node indices, known explicit interventions
source.future_queries: 4 genuinely new intervention-conditioned one-step causal targets on novel state histories, private labels held only for evaluation
source.source_identity: t37-R/S-train/dev distinct from all prior Wingless cohorts, new seeds
source.time_horizon: persistent public constraint memory across 3 intervention sequences; variable delayed entity bindings
